SECTION 23 / CORE SYLLABUS
08. RBAC and Least Privilege

SIMPLE ENGLISH
Role-based access control maps roles to permissions; least privilege grants only the access
necessary.
සිංහJලෙන් Admin, customer වැනි roles වලට permissions assign කරනවා. Role එක තිබුණතේ resource
ownership සහ tenant access Jවනම check කරන්න ඕන.
A cashier can create orders but cannot change administrator roles.

VISUAL MODEL · 1 · 2 · 3 · 4 · User role · Permission mapping · Resource scope · Allow action · Follow the controls from left to right · Read the diagram: User role → Permission mapping → Resource scope → Allow action. Admin, customer වැනි · roles වලට permissions assign කරනවා. Role එක තිබුණතේ resource ownership සහ tenant access Jවනම check · කරන්න ඕන.

Does RBAC alone prevent IDOR? No; object-level access checks still matter.
